title: A five-minute end-of-day shutdown ritual
summary: A short routine to help work stay at work.
body: When you are covering extra work it is easy to carry it home in your head. A repeatable ritual gives your brain a clear stop signal.
steps: Write down anything unfinished, with the very next step for each.
Pick the one most important task for tomorrow.
Close your email and chat, and tidy your desk or workspace.
Say or think a closing phrase, such as “that’s enough for today”.
